ask: codeaf's prebuilt Factory: a jobs list, a job page, repos, pipelines, and runners from codeaf. AI never starts, approves, assigns or ranks a job.
name: Factory

data.line: Job · title, state, manual priority, repo, assignee, issue
Repo · name, open issues, last PR
Pipeline · name and status, from codeaf
Runner · name and host, from codeaf Settings → Factory

screens.line: Jobs list · state and manual priority. A person opens or starts a job.
Job page · the job, its run, review and timeline. codeaf shows them.
Repos · each repo, its open issues and last PR
Pipelines · codeaf pipelines. No agent run starts a job.
Runners · from codeaf, Settings → Factory. This app does not build them.
Activity · what happened. No AI writes it.

agent.line: Factory agent · answers questions. AI never starts, approves, assigns or ranks a job.
